verdict.rationale: Browser-based session access is a fair question for a remote-desktop product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence contains no first-party claim of a browser-only viewer or controller. Community reports describe the get.teamviewer.com invitation page as only launching the installed app through a protocol handler, or else prompting a download, which implies an installed client is required.

support.subject: As a power user, someone can view or control a session from a plain browser with nothing installed
